map.intro: Type your field's address, or tap your field on the map.
map.label: Map. Tap a spot to add a field there.
map.hint: In Poland a tap adds the land register parcel at that spot. Near the Iowa demo field it adds that field's outline, elsewhere a 200 m by 200 m square (4 ha). Tap a field you already added to select it.
map.tiles.reason: The demo field buttons still work.
